title: Fiat aur legal tender alag karo
instruction: Rule-board bharo. Fiat value ka base batata hai; legal tender official payment status. Bitcoin ke dated cards alag stages par rakho.

pieces.label: Govt-recognised debt/transaction money
pieces.right: Government is money ko apni territory mein debts aur transactions settle karne ke liye officially acceptable maanta hai.
pieces.wrong: Sirf trust ya voluntary payment ko definition banaane se official recognition chhoot jaayega.

pieces.label: Book rule: legal tender fiat ho
pieces.right: Book 'must be fiat' kehti hai, lekin exception bhi deti hai; ise exception-free universal rule nahi bana rahe.
pieces.wrong: Is line ko absolute definition banaane se book ka Bitcoin example contradict karega.

pieces.label: Bitcoin: non-fiat, El Salvador tender
pieces.right: Book ke till-2024 account mein Bitcoin non-fiat hote hue legal tender tha: dono categories identical nahi.
pieces.wrong: Bitcoin ko fiat banaane se exception mit jaayega; post-reform slot mein rakhne se historical status mix hoga.

pieces.label: 2025: voluntary Bitcoin use legal
pieces.right: Book ke mutabik ownership aur voluntary use legal rahe, lekin reforms ke baad practical compulsory legal-tender sense nahi raha.
pieces.wrong: Voluntary legal use ko compulsory acceptance maanoge toh legal use aur legal tender ka farq tootega.

pieces.label: Commemorative: fiat yes, tender check
pieces.right: Book ke mutabik commemorative coins fiat hain, par legal tender ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi; most legal tender hain.
pieces.wrong: Fiat hote hi har commemorative coin automatically legal tender maanoge toh 'may or may not' kho jaayega.

win: Value ka base, official recognition aur voluntary use—teenon alag pehchaane.
